about: 50 sides of the J5 v1 sample (Lichess open database, CC0; players' names, game ids and dates removed): the PGN movetext with Lichess's %eval and %clk, the pinned engine's answers for every position the pipeline searched, and the per-side record (the five game_players inputs) build-baseline.ts produced. Regenerate only with build-baseline.ts --sample-fixture after a reviewed change.
